payload.summary: Two fresh analysts re-reviewed the iteration-1 result and found 12 residual items (3 high, 7 medium, 2 low); all were fixed. The local trust boundary now lives in the router first (lane projection) with the resolution guard as defense in depth; task 2.0 proves the v1.3 merge by blob hash and gates both wp-router chains; the provider-less model change (tier alias to concrete alias) is stated; every test task names its module.
completed_work: [high] testability: D2 and agent-archetypes.1/.5 state the tier-alias to concrete-alias model change
[high] feasibility: task 2.0 uses change_dir(), origin/main ancestry, pinned blob hashes, v1.3 code check; 3.1 depends on 2.0
[high] feasibility: install.sh --check moved out of per-package verification to task 4.2
[medium] consistency: D7 two-layer enforcement; vendor_registry.py in scope; refusal reason string fixed
[medium] consistency: order_applied fully required and unique in all three contract files
[medium] testability: UnservableProviderError and claude_agent_runner reference adapter
[medium] ambiguity: candidate without assignment is ineligible; fallback disabled only when assignments are disabled
[medium] feasibility: client loader check named (load_routing_policy_document, ValueError text, populated fixture)
[medium] testability: phase-record-compaction and vendor-neutral-autopilot tests in wp-dispatch verification; smoke output keys named
[low] completeness: configured-fallback reason implies non-null selected in both schemas
[low] consistency: vacuous clause moved to model-routing.8; prose-guard test named; test modules named; parity owned by 2.1

decisions.title: Local trust boundary enforced at lane projection, resolution guard kept as defense in depth (D7)
decisions.rationale: A resolution-time refusal persisted a routed local decision while dispatching static, the attribution gap that ruled out Approach 2. Advertising only trusted archetypes on local lanes makes the router exclude them with lane:archetype-ineligible, so the persisted decision matches dispatch.

decisions.title: Task 2.0 proves the v1.3 merge by change_dir() plus pinned blob hashes, and gates 3.x too (D8)
decisions.rationale: A literal changes/ path breaks on archival and a branch commit SHA does not survive a squash merge; blob ids do. 3.1 depending on 2.0 closes the gap where router edits could start before the gate.

decisions.title: order_applied is a verbatim copy of the fallback block: all four lists required and unique (D6)
decisions.rationale: Optional lists let two implementations validate; the record must be reproducible.

decisions.title: Provider-less dispatch changes the model to the tier's concrete alias, provider unchanged (D2)
decisions.rationale: resolve_provider_model_spec passes the raw tier through without a provider; applying claude_code first maps standard to sonnet. Stating it keeps agent-archetypes.1/.5 testable.

decisions.title: install.sh --check leaves per-package verification; task 4.2 runs it from the feature worktree
decisions.rationale: It diffs against gitignored mirrors that an isolated package worktree does not have.
